ranked.headline: Deep models recover regulatory structure from single-cell and spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Foundation-scale pretraining and knowledge-guided architectures now target regulatory inference across scRNA-seq, spatial, ATAC and Hi-C data.

ranked.headline: Spatial omics models yield interpretable tissue readouts under statistical constraints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair benchmarking and quality metrics with alignment, clustering, and phenotyping tools, making spatial omics results more comparable.

ranked.headline: ML-guided prioritization of small-molecule hits and antibody binders
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair deep learning and MD with experimental tests of predicted binders and potencies.

ranked.headline: Reference-anchored benchmarks reveal variability in genomic variant detection pipelines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add truth sets, simulators, and duplex-sequencing benchmarks that quantify variant caller performance across platforms.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models advance protein design, docking, and variant prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple predicted structures with flow matching, few-shot transformers, and synthetic training data for biomolecular design and prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned and statistical models for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and integration methods now target single-cell and spatial data across platforms, with explicit evaluation of learned clustering and imputation.

ranked.headline: Redesigning models for compositional, high-dimensional molecular measurements
ranked.summary: Modeling-stage redesigns now target zero handling, log-ratio features, and scale misspecification in sequencing and mass-spectrometry data.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and long-read data refine gene annotation and candidate gene prioritization
ranked.summary: Long-read genomes and transcriptomes now expose annotation gaps across inbred mouse strains and diverse human ancestries.

ranked.headline: Functional annotations and learned priors refine variant and gene association testing
ranked.summary: Regulatory, multitrait, rare-variant and fine-mapping methods are now adding functional and Bayesian priors to genetic association analysis.

ranked.headline: Read-level indexing and k-mer methods resolve variants and tandem repeats
ranked.summary: Alignment-free and compressed-index methods now infer variants and repeat structure directly from short and long sequencing reads.

ranked.headline: Isotope-labeling software extends 13C flux analysis to nonstationary and untargeted data
ranked.summary: Recent platforms integrate untargeted and targeted labeling data and extend 13C flux analysis to isotopically nonstationary experiments.

ranked.headline: Graph, contrastive and foundation models learn omics representations for cancer biology
ranked.summary: Multi-center cohorts, multi-omic profiles and single-cell atlases push models toward site invariance, interpretability and cross-modality integration.

ranked.headline: Physics-based models link cell geometry, spatial niches and population dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair physics-driven simulation and single-cell or spatial data to infer biophysical parameters and dynamics from observations.

ranked.headline: Ontology and structure priors are being built into protein prediction models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers embed GO ontologies, interface graphs and 3D surfaces into protein prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict TCR, MHC, and antibody recognition of antigens
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and deep learning frameworks test immune receptor-antigen prediction on unseen complexes and on B cell and antibody targets.

ranked.headline: Stability, criticality and excitability constrain neural dynamics across scales
ranked.summary: Unified and theory-neutral frameworks now link single-neuron excitability, circuit stability and whole-brain criticality across human and animal data.

ranked.headline: Omics tools for biomarker panels, drug target prioritization, and RNA-DNA interactions
ranked.summary: Integrative web portals and R/Bioconductor packages now bring machine learning over multi-omics and network data to biomarker and target selection.

ranked.headline: Read-based haplotype inference extends to polyploid phasing with uncertainty estimates
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend read-based haplotype inference to polyploid, mixed-population, and single-cell settings.

ranked.headline: Synthetic data and generative models for biomedical representation learning
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair generative augmentation and stochastic training with self-supervised learning for missingness and privacy constraints.

ranked.headline: Parameter guidelines and benchmarks for scalable tools in molecular and sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Recent items supply parameter guidance, collision-free hashing, and benchmarks for tools that process large molecular and sequence datasets.

ranked.headline: Accelerated tools for scRNA-seq quantification, duplicate marking and genomic denoising
ranked.summary: Recent reports present faster, scalable implementations for scRNA-seq, synthetic tag, duplicate marking and genomic coverage processing.

ranked.headline: Standardized workflows and curated references for microbial metagenomic profiling
ranked.summary: Expanding reference resources, from a 1.7-million-gene vaginal catalog to a 10,683-metagenome Danish atlas, now pair with standardized analysis logic.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings predict molecular outcomes across omics and drug association tasks
ranked.summary: Recent work applies language-model and graph-based representations to disease risk, perturbation response, and drug association prediction.

ranked.headline: Duplication and sequence models reveal regulatory element evolution and function
ranked.summary: Genome-scale sequence, chromatin, and RNA-seq resources now let duplication and sequence models infer regulatory architecture directly.

ranked.headline: ML tools extract single-cell phenotypes from time-lapse and label-free microscopy
ranked.summary: Label-free and transient-fluorescence imaging now yields quantitative single-cell phenotypes that feed classification and physics-guided design workflows.

ranked.headline: Parameter inference for stochastic and dynamic models limited by cost and identifiability
ranked.summary: Non-Markovian simulation, neural estimators, and identifiability workflows now target the cost and reliability of inference in mechanistic models.

ranked.headline: Interpretable learning methods extract brain biomarkers from neuroimaging data
ranked.summary: Longitudinal, dynamic, and multimodal brain data increasingly demand biomarkers that are interpretable and replicable.

ranked.headline: Software tools standardizing glycan, interface, nanobody and cryoEM data access
ranked.summary: Recent tools address interoperability of glycan nomenclatures, complex interfaces, nanobody records, and cryoEM archive metadata.

ranked.headline: Statistical inference of pathogen dynamics from surveillance and sequence data
ranked.summary: Large, sparse surveillance datasets now demand inference methods that stay tractable while linking sampling timeliness to forecast accuracy.

ranked.headline: Compact indexes and embeddings enable fast search over large sequence collections
ranked.summary: Growing sequence collections, from 16S references to plasmids and Starships, demand compact representations and fast search.

ranked.headline: Phenotype-supervised decomposition links multi-omic layers to trait prediction
ranked.summary: Multi-omic sequencing datasets with phenotype labels now support supervised methods that separate technical from phenotypic structure.

ranked.headline: Sampling protein conformational ensembles and folding pathways beyond single structures
ranked.summary: Experimental data and sequence-based models now yield ensembles and pathways rather than one static protein structure.

ranked.headline: Atom-level active-site geometry guiding enzyme scaffold design and substrate prediction
ranked.summary: Atom-level scaffolding and geometry-based filters now make active-site geometry an explicit design variable for enzymes.

ranked.headline: Reduced models map tunable parameters to defined input-output behavior in gene circuits
ranked.summary: Gene circuits are being engineered for Turing pattern control, perceptron computation, and protein neural networks sharing translational resources.

ranked.headline: Model validity limits and coexistence motifs in microbial consumer-resource communities
ranked.summary: Recent studies define when Lotka-Volterra fails and which motifs permit coexistence, shifting focus to model validity in microbial dynamics.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative design of RNA and single-stranded DNA sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a peer-reviewed tool extend sequence design to explicit 3D structural and motif-level targets for nucleic acids.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools make phylogenetic, pangenome, and circadian analyses more accessible
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published application wrap specialized analysis steps in usability-oriented interfaces for researchers working outside…

ranked.headline: LLMs applied to single-cell annotation and cell-cell relation extraction
ranked.summary: Ontology-guided and multi-agent LLM tools now target hierarchical, interpretable annotation of single-cell transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Simulations link fibrosis, valve calcification, and flow obstacles to cardiac function
ranked.summary: Multiscale cardiac models now couple fluid-structure mechanics with systems biology and electromechanical remodeling in atria.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve how peptides, ligands and glycans reshape protein conformation
ranked.summary: All-atom and steered MD now span peptide-MHC, GPCR and glycosylated receptor systems in the current set of preprints.
